About us

HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180+ agents that orchestrate end-to-end processes across Order-to-Cash, Close & Reconciliation,  Consolidation & Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. 

HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3-6 month go-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.

Summary

A hands-on Manager to own HighRadius's web platform and marketing analytics infrastructure, ensuring clean attribution, strong technical SEO health, and reliable lead data while leading a team. This role sits at the intersection of marketing technology, web operations, and analytics. The Manager wi l be responsible for keeping HubSpot and the CDP layer clean and reliable, managing the WordPress site, monitoring AWS server logs for performance and crawl issues, and ensuring leads are accurately attributed across Organic and Paid channels in a non-branded paid search environment. A strong grasp of Core Web Vitals and cross-region, cross-device optimization is essential to improving impression share globaly. 

Responsibilities 

• Own HubSpot & CDP infrastructure: Manage HubSpot in conjunction with CDPs to ensure clean data flow, accurate lead records, and reliable handoffs between marketing automation and the sales/CRM stack.

• Manage the WordPress environment: Oversee day-to-day site management on WordPress, including content updates, plugin/theme maintenance, page performance, and coordination with developers on fixes and enhancements.

• Add technical ski l requirements • Monitor AWS server health: Review AWS server logs to identify uptime issues, latency, crawl errors, or anomalies impacting site performance and SEO, and work with engineering to resolve them.

• Lead and develop the team: Manage day-to-day priorities, mentor, and review the output of team spanning technical SEO, web operations, and analytics functions. • Drive accurate lead attribution: Ensure leads generated are correctly attributed across Organic and Paid channels, maintaining clean UTM hygiene and resolving attribution gaps given that HighRadius does not bid on branded keywords, in close coordination with marketing analytics and SFDC reporting.

• Champion Core Web Vitals: Own Core Web Vitals performance (LCP, INP, CLS) across the site, partnering with engineering on fixes that improve page experience and search visibility.

• Improve global impression share: Identify opportunities to grow organic impressions and visibility across target geographies (US, UK, Ireland, Canada, France, DACH, etc.), tailoring strategy by region.

• Optimize across devices: Maintain strong technical and UX performance on both mobile and desktop, ensuring parity in speed, rendering, and search performance across device types.

Technical Skills Required

● Backend: PHP, OOP 

● CMS: WordPress (Custom Themes, Plugins, Theme Customization)

● Database: MySQL, SQL

● Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, React.js, Next.js

● CRM: HubSpot

● Servers: Linux, FTP/SFTP

● APIs: GraphQL, REST APIs (optional but recommended)

Must Haves

• 5-8 years of experience in web development, MarTech, and web analytics within a B2B SaaS or enterprise environment.

• 5-8 years of hands-on experience with HubSpot and Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), including configuration, data syncing, and troubleshooting.

 • Working knowledge of WordPress administration, including plugins, themes, and basic site management.

• Comfortably reading and interpreting AWS server logs to diagnose performance and crawlability issues.

• Proven people management experience, having led a team of 4 or more individual contributors.

• Strong understanding of marketing attribution, UTM tracking, and channel-level lead classification (Organic vs. Paid).

• Solid grasp of Core Web Vitals and technical SEO fundamentals, with experience driving cross-functional fixes.

• Experience optimising for both mobile and desktop performance, with familiarity across multiple geographic markets.

About Tetriz

Tetriz helps engineering orgs become AI-native, faster.
Observability that turns AI blind spots into measured signals, coaching that improves how engineers direct AI, and governance that catches risk without surveillance.

The role

This is an Associate Product Marketing Manager (APMM) role. 

Most of our marketing already runs on AI agents. We have a content engine built on Claude (for SEO blogs, founder LinkedIn content, Reddit programs, YouTube scripts), outbound infrastructure on Apollo/Hubspot, and competitive intelligence workflows. 

If your instinct when given a repetitive task is "I should build a skill/workflow for this," you'll fit. If your instinct is to open a blank doc, this will frustrate you.

What you'll own

1. Content engine

• 

Run the SEO blog pipeline end to end: briefs, drafts, editorial QA against our standards, publishing, and refresh cycles

• 

Ship LinkedIn posts and company page content on a weekly calendar

• 

Draft and iterate YouTube scripts, titles, descriptions, and thumbnails for CTR

• 

Keep website and landing page copy current; run CRO experiments as traffic scales

2. Outbound and growth ops

• 

Own the email and social media outbound machine: Sequences, list building and enrichment, deliverability hygiene

• 

Experiment with new outbound channels every quarter

• 

Track and report campaign performance weekly; kill what's not working

3. Launch and channel presence

• 

Run launch-week execution, across relevant platforms.

• 

Build and maintain our G2 and Capterra presence: profile setup, review generation campaigns, response management

• 

Engage in relevant communities where our buyers actually are

4. Lifecycle and customer marketing

• 

Own the PLG email lifecycle: onboarding nurture for new signups, activation prompts, and executive-facing ROI report emails

• 

Produce case studies and capture named customer quotes from active deployments

• 

Keep sales assets current: pitch deck updates, one-pagers, battlecards, teaser video iterations.

What we need

• 

2–3 years in B2B marketing execution. SaaS strongly preferred, dev-tools or selling-to-engineers a big plus

• 

AI-native. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily as a working tool, not a novelty. You can show us prompts, workflows, or agents you've built to do your job faster. This is the single biggest filter.

• 

Strong communication skills. You'll edit AI output for a technical US audience, you need the judgment to catch what's generic, wrong, or off-brand

• 

Ops discipline. Outbound infrastructure fails quietly. You check the dashboard before anyone asks

Nice to have: experience with Apollo.io, Hubspot or similar sales engagement tools, basic SEO fundamentals, familiarity with the developer tools ecosystem, video editing basics.

What you'll get

• 

A front-row seat to a US GTM launch, working directly with the founders

• 

The most AI-leveraged marketing stack you'll find at any company this size, you'll build skills most marketers won't have for years

• 

Real ownership from week one. No approval chains, no busywork
